published_insights.text: [Low] Ir Swap (screen) › Trades: 2 of 6 users / 2 sessions: repeated Trades 3 times 1–10 s apart with no visible state change (2 sessions); No abandonment observed; median 5.2 s lost per affected user. Likely cause: the first Trades gave no visible confirmation, so users repeated it. Fix: confirm Trades on Ir Swap (screen) with a visible state change or message. Evidence: http://localhost/project/1/replay/01a21a9e-b743-7eb6-92dd-5546416c4fab?t=0 @0:00, http://localhost/project/1/replay/01a21a9d-6c2d-77dc-b51f-433b49a9106f?t=1 @0:01, http://localhost/project/1/replay/01a21a9d-6c2d-77dc-b51f-433b49a9106f?t=5 @0:05. Signals: D14, confidence med.

cohorts.text: [Low] Cap / Floor (screen) › Save: single session: clicked Save and got a visible validation error 3 times in a row, editing fields between attempts (1 sessions, 6.9 s per loop); No abandonment observed; median 6.9 s lost per affected user. Likely cause: the requirement behind the validation error shown after Save is not visible before clicking, so the edits users make between attempts do not resolve it. Fix: on Cap / Floor (screen), validate the fields Save depends on inline as they are filled, and name the failing field next to Save instead of only in the error message. Evidence: http://localhost/project/1/replay/01a21aa2-ad3b-74f5-a359-29ef82e35c10?t=14 @0:14. Signals: D4, confidence low.

Fix: give Apply on Ir Swap (screen) an immediate pressed/disabled state and a progress indicator while its action runs. cohorts.text: [Medium] Trade List (screen) › Scroll container: 3 of 3 users / 3 sessions: scrolled 1.7× the visible height in Scroll container with 5 direction reversals, without clicking or typing between reversals (3 sessions; page extent ≥ 1055 px); No abandonment observed; median 6.0 s lost per affected user. Likely cause: the target in Scroll container on Trade List (screen) is hard to find by scrolling (5 up/down reversals of at least a quarter screen each, no search or filter used). Fix: on Trade List (screen), put search/filter above Scroll container, sort the most likely target first, and keep the list short by default.
